title: How to Do Kettlebell Deadlifts the Right Way at Home
hook: Kettlebell deadlifts are a great exercise you can do at home, but most people do them wrong.
body: Put the weight between your legs, not in front of you. Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width and your toes facing forward. Look up at the ceiling as you lift so your back doesn't round out. Then squeeze your glutes at the top of every rep instead of pushing your hips forward.
close: Try these four tips and tell me in the comments how they work for you.
youtube_description:
Most people do kettlebell deadlifts wrong. These four form tips help you get more out of every rep and protect your back.

Try your free Abs By AI preview: https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=kettlebell-deadlift&utm_content=ds-18

1. Put the weight between your legs, not in front of you.
2. Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, toes facing forward.
3. Look up at the ceiling as you lift so your back doesn't round out.
4. Squeeze your glutes at the top of the rep instead of pushing your hips forward.
